lines: Today's question we will be answering: Are Brothels Hotspots For Spoilage?
At Lovro Square, we look towards the well-known Repose Brothel to dig deeper into the truth.
Managed by a band of prostitutes, their reputation is regarded as top-notch by many male customers.
However, rumor is, a cherished fellow worker named Dusan visited their establishment and was infected shortly after with Spoilage.
The community of Lovro Square has remained silent about the issue, but we have reason to believe there is more to the story.
When we sent Boris to Repose to ask further questions, he was blocked by a prostitute named Ana from entering the building.
